1.0: Okay, here it is. Please handle it with care. This silk is very hard to get, and if any part of this fabric is ripped, the queen will put you in jail, #p2101004#.

QuestInfo.name: Stealing Queen's Order of Silk
QuestInfo.0: Your first mission as a Sand Bandit is to steal a batch of silk that the queen ordered. Disguised as #p2101004#, you must go to #b#m260010600##k and get the silk from #b#p2101013##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2101013# keeps giving you suspicious looks. Arrrgh... You better be a smooth talker and just get the #bsilk#k.
QuestInfo.2: You finally got the silk from #p2101013#. Phew, it really is hard to pretend to be someone else. Better return to #p2101010# now!
